parts.text: I did not come here to fight.
Easy. I am just cutting wood.
I mine. I do not brawl.
Keep that blade away from me.
This is not the hill I want.
I fish. I do not fight.
Hold on. I have a rod, not a sword.
Let me be. The river is waiting.
I am on an errand, not a fight.
Stand aside. I have walking to do.
Hold on. I am not a fighter.
Guards! The road is not safe.
The pack is heavy. I will not swing well.
Take the ore if you must. Leave me the feet.
I call for help and I back away.
Axe for trees. Not for you.
I have a word for you.
Stay left. I will cover you.
Come on. I need the practice.
Do not step into my line.
I do not stay for steel.
You wanted a brawl. I wanted a door.
Guards will hear you. I will not.
A pack is not a fair fight.
I will not die for a lift.
The window is closer than you.
Keep the gold. Keep the noise.
Night take you. I take the alley.
Easy. The beast is not for you.
I will not send them at a crowd.
Call off. This is a field, not a pit.
If you swing, I run with them.
A wild pack is your problem.
Keep the blade from the animal.
I command them away, not at you.
I will not lose a named beast to your pride.
Stand off. They can smell blood.
The road is wide. Use it.
I came to walk. Not to war.
Vas an nox, everyone stay close.
An ex por, he is stuck.
Rez me, I am right here.
Vas ort flam, then corp por.
He is at half, keep going.
Do not chase into the gate.
Cut him off at the bridge.
Mana low, give me a moment.
I will take the hits, you cast.
Hit the one I am on.
An ort on the air elemental.
Kal vas xen corp, here comes help.
The daemon is on me now.
Keep the daemon off the healer.
Block his path with a wall.
In sanct ylem, he is boxed.
Energy field up, stand behind it.
In sanct grav, that holds them.
Mind blast, he is out of mana.
Ort rel, his mana is gone.
Reveal, wis quas, there he is.
Detect hidden, someone check the trees.
Stay together, he picks off stragglers.
Guild war, anyone blue in black is ours.
War is declared, hit anyone in green.
Red at the Yew moongate, go go.
Three reds at Despise, gearing up.
They have a mage and two dexers.
He is a dexer, kite him.
Hold, let them come to us.
Recall out, regroup at the bank.
Kal ort por, see you at Britain.
Gate to Destard, who is ready?
Mark it, we come back here.
Do not loot until it is clear.
That bolt was mine, admit it.
Carve the corpse, we need the head.
Bring the head to the guards.
He will be back, stay ready.
He rezzed at the shrine, watch.
He has five counts, he is red.
Do not hit the blue, we will flag.
It is a guard trap, stay out.
He wants us to swing in town.
Wait until he leaves the guard zone.
Out of town, now we fight.
I call this duel. Outside the gate.
I will meet you in the Jhelom pit.
Take my hand, you fought well.
I do not strike a fallen man.
Troll pack, pull one at a time.
Pull, do not wake the whole cave.
Wyverns poison, keep a cure ready.
Dragon at the gate of Destard.
Ancient wyrm? We need more people.
The balron is too much for four.
Lich lords cast hard, reflect up.
Vas flam, vas flam, keep him busy.
In vas por, hold your ground.
He is invulnerable? No, just parrying.
His armor is good, go magic.
Rush the caster before he finishes.
He gated away, find the rune.
He is hiding behind the bank.
Detect hidden sweep, walk with me.
Watch the healer, they keep healing him.
Their bard is peacing us, kill him.
Bard is provoking the dragon onto us!
Provoke the ogres onto each other.
My music is not working, fall back.
Axe for the trees, sword for them.
Spear reach, keep them off me.
I am green, someone an nox me.
Heal the archer, she is low.
Two heals on me, I am okay.
Stop healing him, he is enemy.
Rez pls, I am on the corpse.
Ghost at the gate, bring a rez.
I will rez you after the fight.
Get your gear, we hold the room.
Grab your bag and recall out.
Dress fast, they are coming back.
Suit up from the bank, then return.
Fight in cheap armor, keep the good stuff banked.
Bring a spare suit next time.
Hit the orc, not the tree.
You hit me! Watch your aim.
Keep the fields off our side.
Stand in the doorway, choke point.
Back to the stairs, hold there.
Lever on the wall, pull it.
We stop here, the lich room is next.
One more room, then we bank.
Bag is full, I need a bank run.
Heavy pack, I cannot move fast.
Drop the junk, keep the gold.
Loot the gold, leave the leather.
Who needs arrows? I have spare.
He cannot reach me up here.
Up the rocks, shoot from there.
Mage has low armor, hit the mage.
Hythloth is no joke, bring a healer.
Knight of the Hold, hold fast.
Blood on the blade is fine.
Say the word and I strike.
Stand on the gate so nobody gets through.
They are coming through the gate.
Gate camping, they wait on the other side.
Do not take that gate, it is a trap.
Bunch up for the arch cure.
Heal pot, heal pot, heal pot.
I hate fighting in the dark.
Ghost again, never saw it coming.
I am stuck in the doorway.
Can someone kill that mongbat for me? Kidding.
He ran naked into the forest, lol.
I have fought mongbats braver than you.
Tell your guild I said hi.
Enjoy the walk to the healer.
Nice sword, I will keep it.
We will be here all night.
Get out of our hunting ground.
Leave now and we let you live.
Swords down, or not. Your choice.
He fought well for a pk.
I will see you again, red.
That is ten reds this week.
Put his head on the bounty board.
He had a bounty on him, nice.
Split the loot at the bank.
Fair split, everyone gets a share.
You take the gold, I take the bow.
Guard his corpse until he rezzes.
Get back in there, you are fine.
Serpents Hold knights, form a line.
Wind mages, rain fire on them.
All follow me, we are leaving.
All guard me, he is back.
All stop, that one is blue.
All stay here, I will look.
Not that one, the other one!
Kill the horse, then the rider.
Kill the tamer, the pet stops.
Bandages on the bear, hold still.
Pet down, I need a healer.
My pet died. I will never tame another like it.
Where is the nearest animal trainer?
I am going to the stables.
Stable them, now, before they die.
They go wild if I die.
If I die, my dragon goes wild.
Do not let me die, the drake will turn.
My pet went wild, stay back!
It is not mine any more, run.
Somebody retame that, it was mine.
He stole my pet with his taming.
Kill a person, not a beast.
The beast did nothing to you.
The bear takes the hits, I heal.
Let the wolves take the front.
My dragon is low, pull back.
All come, back to the gate.
Get on, get on the horse.
Llama, why are you so slow?
Pack horse is overloaded, drop the ore.
He is chasing the pack animal!
Keep away from my pack llama.
The packs are on the llama, protect it.
Oh no, a dragon. A wild one.
That dragon is not tame, run.
Someone provoked my pet onto me!
The bard turned my pet against me.
My pet will not attack, he peaced it.
Command failed, it will not listen.
It will not obey, not enough lore.
Too many followers, I cannot control them.
Listen to me, you stubborn beast.
See that? My drake did that.
Tamed him last week, look at him go.
Fire from the drake, stay clear.
Pack of wolves, go get him.
Dire wolf, the one in black.
Hind, run home. Wait, you cannot fight.
Dog, bark at him at least.
I only have a cat. We are in trouble.
My pet rat is not helping.
Stop, the ogre is not ours.
I almost had him tamed and he attacked.
Taming fails, and now it is angry.
I will never tame that thing.
It is fighting back, stop taming.
Stop, you are ruining my tame!
Do not attack, I am taming it.
Back off, I am taming here.
Kill steal, and a tame steal too.
Can you hold it while I tame?
Keep it busy, I need a few more tries.
It bit me while I was taming.
My armor is fur. Mostly the bear.
Stay away from the White wyrm.
Tame the drakes, kill the dragons.
Drakes are easy, dragons are not.
I will live, heal the drake.
Hurt me all you like, not them.
The wolves are all I have.
I raised that bear from a cub.
I spent weeks on that dragon.
Call them off, call them off.
Come back here, you idiot bear.
He is chasing it into the woods.
Lost the pet, it wandered off.
Pet ran off after a rabbit.
Stay with me, not the deer.
Good luck getting past my drake.
Try it, my dragon is hungry.
My pets bite harder than you.
Two dragons behind me, think it over.
That is a lot of teeth, friend.
Do not make me say all kill.
I am warning you, one word.
I will say it. All kill.
Heh, nice try, but the bear saw you.
Count them, one, two, three. Good.
Missing one, where is the hart?
Help! Something is eating my wolf!
Red by the Yew stables, watch your pets.
Heal me, I cannot heal and command.
I am a tamer, I cannot fight alone.
Without the pets I am nothing.
My dragon is stabled, I am helpless.
Wrong day to leave the drake home.
I left the bear in the stable. Why?
Run, I have no pets out.
Pets are in the stable, I am just a person.
Great, my pets are at the bank.
Anyone? A tamer with no pets is lunch.
Why do reds always find the tamers?
Stop, I am just walking the horse.
Calm down, big guy, calm down.
Release the hounds. Well, the wolves.
Bear, the one in the robe.
All kill the mage, he is peacing.
Kill the bard, he keeps provoking.
Kill the tamer first, then his pets.
His dragon is bigger than mine.
Two tamers, two dragons, this is ugly.
My drake against yours, come on.
His pets are wild now, careful.
His pet went wild, tame it!
Quick, someone tame the loose drake.
The loose dragon is attacking everyone.
Guards will not touch the pets.
The guards cut down my wolf!
Guards, not the pet, not the pet!
The guards hit the horse, why?
Kill it before the guards do.
Do not bring pets into the bank.
Keep your wolves out of the bank.
My bear did not mean it.
Sorry, the wolf did that on its own.
It will not stop, I said stop.
He is blue, leave him alone.
Do not flag me, stupid wolf.
Great, my pet flagged me grey.
Now I am grey because of the dragon.
The wolf attacked a blue, sorry!
They are hitting my dragon, hit back!
Protect the tamer, not the pets!
Kill him, he killed my wolf.
Next time it will be a dragon.
You will see my dragon soon.
Wait until my lore is higher.
I am still learning, give me a break.
Only a hind. I am new.
I only tamed a rabbit so far.
My first bear, and you kill it?
Bear is bleeding, pull him back.
Bring the horse to the healer.
Vet skill, anyone? My drake is dying.
I pay double for pet heals.
The drake is poisoned, cure it.
Poison on the pack, I cannot cure them all.
I cannot keep them all alive.
Losing the wolves one by one.
Leave the bear. No, never mind, come.
All follow me, to the gate.
Through the moongate, all of you.
Wait, the drake did not follow.
Recall and I lose the pets.
Cannot recall, the pets will stay.
No recall, I walk home with them.
Guard the pets while I get help.
Watch the pets while I bank.
Do not touch my horse while I am inside.
Someone is killing horses outside the bank.
Why would anyone kill a llama?
The ostard was just standing there.
That was a pack animal, not a fighter.
Leave the beasts out of it.
Fine, you want a fight? All kill.
I warned you. Now meet the bear.
Back off, or the drake gets a snack.
I would run, if I were you.
Hungry wolves, friend. Think it over.
Run faster, they like a chase.
Hope you have a fast horse.
You get raw ribs for that.
Take the gold, I feed them later.
Carve him, the pets need meat.
Skara Brae rangers, a pk at the ferry!
Yew rangers, help, reds at the stables.
Pets are not allowed in the pit, sadly.
Moonglow, the pets hate the gate.
Britain stables, a pk with a halberd!
Vesper docks, my llama fell in. Kidding.
Papua jungle, the beasts go wild here.
That frenzied bird is not mine, scatter!
Pigs. Why are the pigs angry?
Great, a harpy took the hart.
Snakes in the grass, careful, pets.
Alligator in the swamp, pets back.
Scorpions in the desert, stay close.
Giant scorpion by the rocks, careful.
Big lizard in the river, all come.
Stay out of the water, wolves.
The drake cannot swim, go around.
Boat is full of pets, turn back.
Sea serpent! Hold the pets back.
Pets cannot fight from the boat.
All guard me, pirates on board.
Off the boat, all follow me.
Cove orcs are after the horses.
Ocllo farm, wolves on the sheep.
Nujelm, my cat hates the heat, and you.
Serpents Hold, a knight hit my drake.
Wind mages cast at my pets, stop!
Covetous harpies, pets to the entrance.
Shame, the elementals ignore my pets.
Despise, the orcs flee from the bear.
Liches! Pets back, too much magic.
Mongbat, even the cat can take it.
Imps, the cat is not happy.
Reaper by the trees, pets clear.
Earth elemental, the bear is losing.
Water elemental, pets out of the water.
Air elemental knocked the drake down.
Not me, I was over here.
Check your pack, it is all there.
Look behind you. Nope, not there either.
I am blue, he is the grey one.
You flagged on me, now the guards know.
Hit me in town, go on.
Go ahead, swing. I dare you.
I stand under the guard post.
Run to town, run to town.
I am just a beggar, sir.
Poor beggar, no gold, go away.
Kill me, you get a lockpick.
Take the picks, I have more.
Ship leaves at night, get on.
Out to sea, they cannot follow.
Wait for the guards to pass.
Magic lock on the door, an por.
I did not trap that. Well, maybe.
Kryss is quick, I am quicker.
Is that a sword or a stick?
He is chasing me with a halberd!
Leave me alone, I am innocent.
Look at my name, still blue.
Guards! I was robbed! Wait, no.
That man in the red cloak did it.
Criminal flag, hide for two minutes.
Grey for two minutes, stay hidden.
Still grey, do not show yourself.
Teleport, rel por, up the wall.
I am a tailor, see? Thread.
Never carry what you cannot lose.
Help! A red is after me.
Pk on my tail, heading to Britain.
Reds at the bank, stay hidden.
Hide, a pk just gated in.
Stay low, reds on the road.
He walked right past me, heh.
Right past me. Blind as a bat.
He cannot see me, he cannot hit me.
Dexer on me, need the stairs.
Mage on me, break line of sight.
Into the tavern, out the back.
He is at the front, I am at the back.
The horse is a good wall.
He forgot the guard post was right there.
He attacked me in town, lol.
He swung in town. Guards, please.
Help the poor thief. Nobody? Fair.
I will pay you back. Honest.
Shield me, I will cut you in.
Watch my back, half the take.
Half the loot if you hold him.
Tell him a joke, I will go.
Hold the door, I am coming.
Shut it, he is right behind me.
Run, the chest is about to go.
Keep your hands off my chest. My box, I mean.
That box is trapped, just saying.
So close to a clean lift.
Too heavy to lift, forget it.
The bag is too heavy, drop it.
Drop the loot, save your skin.
Keep the gold, drop the ore.
You want to search me? Heh.
Someone should call the guards. Not me.
I would help, but I am busy.
Wait for me at the Den.
Boat at the Den dock, go.
Turn the ship, they have archers.
Ha, they are on the shore.
Moon is out, stay in shade.
He is tracking me, split up.
Tracker on us, cross the river.
Into the mine, dark in there.
The sewer rats hate me too.
Ratmen in the tunnel, go around.
The dog is barking at me, go.
Orcs? Out here? I am leaving.
Bandits, you picked the wrong mark.
Guild of thieves, not the guards.
Thieves guild, do not hit your own.
Wrong cloak, friend, I am one of you.
He is in our guild, stop.
Oi, guildmate, I am on your side.
Ha, my guild has your back? Wait.
Stab the mage, he cannot cast with a dagger in him.
GM at hiding, novice at dying.
I fight best at a distance. A far distance.
Shoot the one with the lantern.
Their mage can reveal, avoid him.
Wis quas? Not on me you do not.
Hundred people and a thief. Good luck.
Pick me out of that crowd.
They all look alike in grey robes.
Change the cloak, change the face.
Polymorph, vas ylem rel, I am an orc.
Nobody hits an orc in town. Oh wait.
Night sight, in lor. Now I see you.
I see you, you do not see me.
You wanted a thief, you got a thief.
Poisoning my blade, give me a second.
He is poisoned, now we run.
Buy a cure, I will wait. Not really.
The alley is my guild hall.
Jhelom pits? No thanks, too bright.
Trinsic walls have holes, trust me.
Vesper bridges are good for running.
Moonglow is full of revealers. Careful.
Cove gate, ha, no guards at night.
Papua docks, lose them in the cargo.
Pk at the Minoc mine, run!
I only have ore, leave me be.
I am blue, you know you will go grey.
Run, there is a red by the forge.
I have no gold, it is all in the bank.
Why me? I am just chopping.
Get off me, I am mining here.
Ettin at the cave mouth, careful.
Orcs in the trees, get back.
Reaper! It is a reaper, not a tree!
Help, a headless has me cornered.
Heal me and I will pay you.
I dropped my pick, keep going.
Kal ort por, kal ort por, come on.
I cannot run, too much ore.
Drop the ore, drop the ore, run.
Somebody rez me at the healer.
Can anyone rez a poor miner?
I will not fight you, take the logs.
Help at the Yew woods, a pk!
I just got here and you jump me?
Not again. Third time this week.
Run to the guard zone, go!
Grey one there, he stole my ore, get him.
Can someone kill this thing for me?
Harpy on me, harpy on me.
Stay back, I have an axe.
Get it off, get it off!
Lizardman at the river, watch out.
Everyone run, gazer by the pond.
I am going to die for twelve logs.
You can have the fish, I do not care.
Gate out, someone gate me out.
Why is there a troll here?
Call the guards, I am too slow.
Keep swinging, it is almost dead.
I have a family of pickaxes to feed.
Fine, I will hit you with the hammer.
My arm is tired, I cannot swing.
Help, a giant spider in the forest.
Stop it, I have work to do.
Back off or I call the guards.
In mani. In mani. Please work.
An nox, an nox, fizzle again.
Look out, reds on the road.
That is not fair, I have no armor.
Just let me bank my logs.
A bear? Since when are there bears here?
Keep the pick, spare the horse.
This is why I stay in town.
Grey miner, not me, the other one!
Please no, I just smelted all this.
Hey, I saw you loot that!
You will get a count for this.
Guards cannot hear me out here.
I should have stayed at the forge.
Who spawns a dragon near a mine?
Is that a lich? Nope, I am leaving.
My logs are not worth your time.
I am swinging but missing everything.
Why does a snake hurt so much?
A skeleton came out of the ground.
Someone call a healer, I am low.
Stay on the road, stay on the road.
I am telling my guild about you.
Lucky I banked before I came.
I have ten gold, take it and go.
Hold on, I need to drink.
Leave me alone, I craft your armor!
A cow just attacked me. A cow.
Hiding is not my skill, sadly.
Dead again. At least I banked.
Where is the healer from here?
Ghost here, anyone know a rez?
Wait, I am blue, you cannot do that.
I am not worth the murder count.
Kill it, it is hitting my mule.
Please do not kill my llama.
Run, the orc lord is coming.
They are hitting me through the wall.
I cannot see him, he is hidden.
Too many, too many, go back.
I have a bow somewhere in here.
Energy bolt hurts, did you know?
One more hit and I am a ghost.
I will not beg. Well, maybe a little.
Oh, that was a big crit.
Nobody move, the bear is sleeping.
There is a pk camping the gate.
Watch the Minoc road, reds everywhere.
Look, I just want to fish.
Fish bit me. No, that was a sea serpent.
Serpent on the line, cut it!
The water elemental is coming for us.
They jumped me at the bridge.
Tell the guards it was a red.
Can I at least keep my shirt?
Leave the clothes, they are dyed.
I worked hours for that ore.
You call that a fair fight?
My skills are all in carpentry.
Someone opened the house door, get out.
Rez me and I will make you a chair.
I will fix your armor for a heal.
Who has a spare bandage for a smith?
Back to the city, too dangerous.
The ore is not worth dying for.
You can have my hatchet, I have others.
I saw that red earlier, beware.
Warning, pk heading to the bank.
Yell if you see him again.
Not my fight, I am going home.
You there, help a tailor out!
Help, my scissors will not do much.
I am all out of heals.
Keep hitting it, I will bandage.
I am behind you, go go go.
Guards are too far, keep running.
Why do they always come at night?
Hey, this is a guarded town!
Wait for the guards, do not swing.
If you swing first you go grey.
I did not flag, you did.
Escort me to Minoc and I will pay.
Ten gold for an escort to Vesper.
Anyone headed to Britain with a sword?
I pay well for a bodyguard.
I am naked and angry now.
My pack is on my corpse, hurry.
Corpse is by the cave, please guard it.
Do not loot me, I am coming back.
That is my ore on that body.
Somebody drag my body to town.
I lost everything but my boots.
Next time I bring a guard.
Good thing I only carried a little.
I am stuck on the rock, help.
I hit it with a frying pan.
All I have is a skillet.
My kitchen knife will do nothing.
I hope you choke on that ore.
Even the rabbits hate me today.
A giant rat. Why always rats?
Keep your pet away from my sheep.
Wolves are on the cattle again.
The corpser grabbed me, pull me out.
Who puts a corpser by a path?
I cannot move, I am paralyzed.
I am frozen here, kill him first.
Fire field on the path, go around.
I stepped in the poison field.
Walls up, he walled me in.
Give me a moment, I need a bandage.
Pirates on the water, turn the boat.
He is on my boat, get him off.
The sea serpent is chasing us.
Kraken? No. Just a big serpent.
A pack of ghouls near the graves.
Zombies by the cemetery, stay clear.
I hate the Britain graveyard at night.
Mummies do not belong in Moonglow.
Stay out of the swamp, bog things.
Bog thing on the path, careful.
The trolls are at the Vesper bridge.
Hey, that is my tree you are cutting.
Fine, keep the tree. Keep it.
I was here first, go find your own.
Please do not flag on me.
I will not hit back, you pk.
Just wait until my guild hears.
There is a bounty on you now.
I will post a bounty for that.
You are worth a bounty, pk.
Help, the ogre is on the road.
Ogre by the farms, get the guards.
I am too slow for this.
I need to rest, cover me.
Cannot run any more, heal me.
Here, take my bandages, heal yourself.
I will bandage you, stand still.
That is a lot of blood.
I think I am poisoned too.
Did anyone bring an orange potion?
My potions are in the bank.
Out of heal potions, out of luck.
You there, got a yellow pot?
I will trade ingots for a heal.
All right, all right, I am leaving.
It is yours, just let me go.
I will come back with friends.
Get the one in the robe first.
He is a mage, watch the bolts.
He is hiding near the trees.
He went invisible, where did he go?
He gated in with three friends.
Oh no, a gate just opened.
Close the gate, no, wait, run.
Red gate! Do not go in!
That gate goes to a pk hideout.
I never walk into strange gates.
Who opened a gate in the bank?
Wait, I have a recall scroll here.
Scroll, scroll, where is the scroll?
I am out, see you in town.
Made it to the bank. Barely.
I am shaking. That was too close.
We mine in groups now, right?
Stay close to the forge light.
I will make you plate if you save me.
Save me and the next sword is free.
I owe you a shield for that.
Can you walk me home too?
The bandits are back on the Yew road.
Bandit camp by the woods, stay away.
Stop shooting me, I am blue!
I will never outrun a horse.
My horse died. My poor horse.
Who kills a packhorse? Who does that?
My llama had all my cloth.
All my dye was in that bag.
I will never carry that much again.
Guard zone, ha, you cannot touch me.
Cross the line and the guards come.
I am standing under the guards now.
Where are the guards when you need them?
Why did the guards not come?
No guards this far out. None.
The Minoc guards never hear me.
Help! Wolf pack by the Minoc road.
The jungle is full of things with teeth.
Get off the beach, crabs are angry.
Walrus. I lost to a walrus.
Beaten by a sheep. Do not tell anyone.
The llama spat at me. Fair enough.
Frost trolls at the Ice pass.
Too cold to swing an axe.
There is a giant serpent in the reeds.
Ophidians in the jungle, watch out.
Stay away from the Terathan Keep.
Something big in the Lost Lands.
I heard the Lost Lands are safer. Liars.
The Papua road is not safe.
Is that a wyrm? Leave the logs.
An imp threw fire at me.
Energy vortex on the bank steps!
Where did that daemon come from?
